## Install on Windows

1. Download {setup-name} from this release and run it. It installs for your Windows account only, with no admin prompt, and adds VRCFaceTracking to the Start menu.
2. Start VRCFaceTracking. Install your tracking module from the Module Registry tab if you haven't before.
3. Launch VRChat with OSC enabled. The Home tab shows the module as active once it's receiving data.

The setup also registers this copy with SteamVR. If you turned on "Start with SteamVR" for an older copy you extracted by hand, SteamVR starts the installed copy from now on.

To run it without installing, extract {zip-name} anywhere except `Program Files` and run `VRCFaceTracking.exe`.

Settings and installed modules live in `%AppData%\VRCFaceTracking` and are shared with the Steam build, so an existing setup carries over.
